project.name: Retired Spring Boot 3 module (see ADR-0017)
project.description: Retired placeholder, carrying no code. The pre-configured Spring Boot 3 library is gone because Spring Framework 6.2.x no longer receives security fixes, so the lane could not clear a dependency security gate. Use rest-spring-4, the same library built against Spring Boot 4. Note that rest-spring-4 is compiled against Spring Boot 4 APIs and will not load inside a Spring Boot 3 application - to stay on Spring Boot 3, drop this dependency and bring your own Spring Boot 3 main application alongside platform-core instead.

relocation.message: rest-spring-3 is retired: Spring Framework 6.2.x is out of security support. Resolving rest-spring-4 instead, which REQUIRES Spring Boot 4. If your application is still on Spring Boot 3, remove this dependency and bring your own Spring Boot 3 main application alongside platform-core.
